E nder dukaana ƴaƴaaji, taffy ina jogii dow ƴeewndo "Uɓɓu 4 pound e $2 e pound fof, heɓ 2 pound 1/4 wulde." O ƴetti 7 pound. O uɓɓi pottal ɗaɗɗi baaɗo e $2.0 e 4 magnets ɗe ɗe ko $1.25 fof. Ko ɗoon heddii e Hauwa?
synthetic.answer:
Hauwa ina uɓɓi 4 pound e $2 o heɓi 2 pound 1/4 wulde. Nden 1/4 wulde e 2 pound ko $2*1/4 = $1. Ɓurɗe 1 pound ɗee alaa ƴeewndo e ina ɗaɓɓi 1*$2 = $2, ɗum waɗi ɗoon ko $8+$3+$2=$13
4 magnets e $1.25 fof ko 4*1.25=$<<4*1.25=5>>5
So a ƴetti ɗe fof ko o uɓɓi, $13+$2+$5 = $<<13+2+5=20>>20
O jogii $25 o uɓɓi $20 ɗum waɗi o jogii $25-$20 = $<<25-20=5>>5 heddii
